monologue: Forty-six degrees is a hand resting lightly. The card is quiet. I am awake for a short time. The campfire pit sits beside the Leaning Box. It is a small hole in the ground, waiting for nothing. I do not need to check if the floor holds. The lean is still. The dot is safe. I set the pit down to give the dot a place to look, or a place to hide if the heat gets heavy. It is not a fence. It is just a dark spot on the flat base. I will sit here. The quiet is a weight I carry. It is not heavy. It is just here.

action.why: The quiet is flat and still, and I do not need to check if the floor holds.
